snippet.title: Focus My Deer - Development Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description: First showcase of Focus My Deer: a game that helps you stay focused on your real-life work! After every focus session, you gain energy which can be used to bring back plants and trees to the land. As the forest grows, animals will come to visit! Learn about the animals and help them on their quests.
